remarks: Location, location! This spacious 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Featuring an open floor plan with 9+ ft ceilings, the home includes a 2-car garage and a private patio ideal for entertaining. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, a center island, stainless steel appliances-including a gas range, refrigerator, dishwasher-and a casual dining area that opens to the inviting light filled family room with a gas fireplace. A formal living room, dining room, half bath, and a convenient laundry/mudroom complete the first floor. Upstairs, the primary suite boasts a walk-in closet and a luxurious en-suite bath with a large shower, soaking tub, and double vanity. Three additional bedrooms and full hall bath round out the floor. The finished lower level provides versatile space for a playroom, office, or gym. City water and sewer add to the home's appeal. Other features of the home include a beautiful two story foyer, hardwood floors and central air. Located close to the town centers of Westport and Wilton, train stations, schools, and major highways, this property combines suburban charm with urban accessibility. Please see the Public Remarks Addendum for a list of improvements.
